        - paragraph: In simple English
        - heading "Understand F Distribution" [level=2]
        - paragraph: The F distribution is a right-skewed distribution used for ratios of variance estimates. You can learn F Distribution by trying one small example instead of long theory.
        - paragraph: Use numerator and denominator degrees of freedom before reading probabilities. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
        - paragraph: "In real life, anova: F compares between-group and within-group variation. Watch out: Using only one degrees-of-freedom value. F distributions need numerator and denominator degrees of freedom."
        - complementary:
          - generic: Try this example
          - paragraph: F distributions need how many degrees-of-freedom values?
          - generic "Compare your answer"
